dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Razišči vrstni red šivov, barve niti, preskoke, obrobe in strojne ukaze pred proizvodnjo. Predogled dizajna šiv za šivom, preklapljaj med slogi upodabljanja in izvozi, kar vidiš.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Interaktivna simulacija vezenja, pregled in izvoz.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Drži ravnilo ob zaslonu in povleci drsnik, dokler spodnja palica ni natančno 100 mm dolga, nato pritisni V redu.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Kopiraj sliko v polni ločljivosti v odložišče

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Jezik je bil nastavljen na {language}. Ponovno zaženi InkSim, da ga uveljaviš?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Uporabljen bo sistemski privzeti jezik. Ponovno zaženi InkSim, da ga uveljaviš?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Vsa odprta okna programa InkSim bodo zaprta, trenutna datoteka pa bo znova odprta.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Izvoz CSV-ja v Ink/Stitch ni uspel.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Podrobnosti o napaki so v datoteki output.err.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Časovna omejitev predogleda šivov je potekla.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Odpri ta SVG v novem oknu Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: V tej mapi ni podprtih datotek.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Dvoklikni mapo za ogled njenih datotek.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Dvoklikni mapo za ogled njenih datotek.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Za urejanje datotek SVG je potreben Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Potrebna sta konfigurirana namestitev Ink/Stitch in zaganjalnik Pythona.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Datoteka ni veljavna datoteka za vezenje

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Ustvari podatke o šivih iz te datoteke SVG z Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Aktivnega skripta Ink/Stitch ali nastavljenega zaganjalnika Python ni mogoče zagnati.

dialog.open_browser.select_file.translation: Izberi datoteko, ki jo želiš odpreti.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Razširitev Ink/Stitch: preverjanje ni uspelo. Za ponovni poskus uporabi Orodja...

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Razširitev Ink/Stitch: ni najdena v mapah z razširitvami Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Razširitev Ink/Stitch: preverjanje ni mogoče, dokler ni nastavljen Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Razširitev Ink/Stitch: še ni preverjena. Za preverjanje uporabi Orodja...

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Vir SVG. Za predogled šivov je potreben Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Vir SVG. Izberi Predogled, da z Inkscape/Ink/Stitch ustvariš podatke o šivih.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Ta SVG je prevelik za predogled.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Začasne datoteke za predogled ni bilo mogoče ustvariti: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Te vrste datoteke v InkSim ni mogoče odpreti.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Stanja razširitve Inkscape ni bilo mogoče shraniti: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Map z razširitvami InkSim ni bilo mogoče najti.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Map z razširitvami Inkscape ni bilo mogoče pregledati: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Razširitev Inkscape za InkSim ni bilo mogoče namestiti: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Razširitve Inkscape za InkSim so bile nameščene ali posodobljene v {path}. Znova zaženi Inkscape, da jih naloži.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape ni bil najden na sistemski poti.

integration.inkscape.preferences_read_fa.translation: Nastavitev Inkscape ni bilo mogoče prebrati: {error}

integration.inkscape.preferences_write_f.translation: Nastavitev Inkscape ni bilo mogoče posodobiti: {error}

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Map z razširitvami Inkscape ni bilo mogoče prebrati: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Znova zaženi Inkscape, da uveljaviš nov tolmač Python.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Stare mape z razširitvami InkSim ni bilo mogoče odstraniti: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Stare mape z razširitvami InkSim so bile odstranjene. Znova zaženi Inkscape, da osveži seznam razširitev.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.translation: Konfiguracije InkSim ni bilo mogoče shraniti: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Zaznana nastavitev je shranjena v konfiguracijo InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.inkstitch_no.translation: Namestitve Ink/Stitch ni bilo mogoče najti.

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Zahtevanega zaganjalnika »{command}« ni bilo mogoče najti; nastavitev je ostala nespremenjena.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape ni bil najden. Izberi njegovo izvršno datoteko, da pregledaš nastavitev.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Tolmača Python ni bilo mogoče preveriti ali posodobiti: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Nastavitev tolmača Python ni bila preverjena, ker uporabniška mapa z razširitvami ni na voljo.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Znova zaženi Inkscape, da uveljaviš posodobljen tolmač.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape se ni odzval v {seconds} sekundah.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Izberi izvršno datoteko Inkscape za pregled nastavitve.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape se ni odzval v {seconds} sekundah. Drugi primerek Inkscape ali razširitev morda blokira komunikacijo. Zapri druge primerke Inkscape ali onemogoči razširitev, ki blokira komunikacijo, nato poskusi znova.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Zahtevanega zaganjalnika »{command}« ni bilo mogoče najti. Orodje uvr namesti sam z ukazom `uv tool install uvr`, nato znova zaženi to konfiguracijo. InkSim ga ne bo namestil.

integration.inkstitch.not_found.translation: Namestitve Ink/Stitch ni bilo mogoče najti.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Ni naložene datoteke vezenja za izvoz.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Ponastavi širino črte in faktorje senčenja

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Klikni za prilagoditev faktorja temne, svetle in širine črte

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Pogled od spodaj (nariši poznejše šive pod prejšnjimi)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Kroži prikaz preskokov: izklopljeno, vse, samo tvegano
